rationale: A model that leaves out detail need not depict its object as nonphysical, so the step from simplification to an ethereal depiction needs its own argument.

sources.quote: Graziano does not speak of primitiveness here, and he says surprisingly little to apply his attention schema model to the meta-problem.
Graziano occasionally says that the model describes awareness as ‘ethereal’, but he does not really explain why the model should represent awareness as ethereal
